items.title: A covering yields an exact presentation \bigoplus j_{U_i \times_U U_j!}\mathcal{O} \to \bigoplus j_{U_i!}\mathcal{O}_{U_i} \to j_!\mathcal{O}_U \to 0

items.difficulty_reason: The proof transfers exactness contravariantly: for any \mathcal{O}-module \mathcal{F}, applying \Hom_\mathcal{O}(-, \mathcal{F}) turns the presented sequence into the exact sequence 0 \to \mathcal{F}(U) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i \times_U U_j), whose exactness is the sheaf condition recorded in the chapter's displayed equation for maps out of j_!\mathcal{O}_U; the general exactness criterion from Homology then reverses the transfer. The contravariant Hom argument is the substance.
